story:
Why this one matters: Madrid is in the book. Baku is not. Formula1.com lists a Thursday-Saturday weekend at the Baku City Circuit, 6.003 km, 51 laps, 306.049 km.

Sky Sports: qualifying Friday 1 p.m. UK, the Grand Prix Saturday 12 p.m. UK. Baku is four hours ahead of UTC on the official timetable. Drivers after Madrid remain Antonelli 292, Russell 211, Hamilton 191, Norris 186, Leclerc 167. Constructors: Mercedes 503, Ferrari 358, McLaren 306.

Do not print a Baku pole, a safety car or a winner. Practice has not started.
stakes: A Saturday race on a street circuit, with an 81-point lead that has not been tested in Azerbaijan.
rivalryAngle: Mercedes versus the rest, on a track that rewards the long straight and punishes the castle section.
